    ZHEJIANG COOSAI VALVE

    ZHEJIANG COOSAI ball valves are designed for isolation, shut-off and flow-control applications. The range includes floating, trunnion-mounted, fully welded, top-entry, cryogenic, metal-seated and segment designs, with manual, pneumatic, electric or hydraulic operation.
